caption.title: What's missing, at a glance
caption.sub: Before anyone acts on this record, the banner shows what never arrived and what nobody has checked yet.

caption.title: Every document, and how it arrived
caption.sub: As structured data, converted from another lab's format, or read from a scan. Each row says which.

caption.title: Another lab's units, converted on arrival
caption.sub: Regiolab reports in its own units. The value is converted for you, and what they sent stays on record.

caption.title: One code for the same test
caption.sub: Every lab names its tests differently. Mapping each one to LOINC makes them findable, whoever sent them.

caption.title: Some values only exist as a picture
caption.sub: This one never made it into the echo's structured report. It was read from the screen capture.

caption.title: A clinician confirms it
caption.sub: The software only reads. Nothing enters the record until someone has checked it against the image.

caption.title: Signed off, with name and time
caption.sub: Who verified which value, and when, stays with the result.

caption.title: A referral starts with a question
caption.sub: It can't be sent without one, so the receiving department knows what is being asked.

steps.type: Back-referral after chest pain work-up. Please continue follow-up.

caption.title: They see what you see
caption.sub: Checked values travel as data. Unchecked ones travel as images, marked as unchecked.

caption.title: Sent, and on the record
caption.sub: The referral is logged in the patient's audit trail.

caption.title: A result that only came by fax
caption.sub: The emergency department faxed this troponin. There is no electronic copy in the record.

caption.title: Ask through the networks you already use
caption.sub: ZorgMail, Twiin or the regional platform. Nothing new to connect.

caption.title: The regional platform has it
caption.sub: One query on the patient's BSN finds the result the other hospital published.

caption.title: In the record, as structured data
caption.sub: With its source and time of arrival. No retyping, no phone call.

caption.title: When paper still comes in
caption.sub: Fax is the exception now. The sender is recognised by its number, not by what the header claims.

caption.title: Checked before it is filed
caption.sub: Someone confirms the patient and the value. It then enters the record as unverified.

caption.title: Reports with no patient match
caption.sub: They wait here instead of getting lost. Match them by hand or reject them; the original message is kept.

caption.title: Where results still arrive on paper
caption.sub: Per source and per department, so you know which sender to move to a digital channel first.

caption.title: Every look at a record is logged
caption.sub: Who opened what, when, and on what grounds.

caption.title: Exported per patient
caption.sub: When a patient asks who has seen their data, the answer is one export away.
